structure: A Playwright trace corpus of the animals frontend's fit suite (repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend, run at 4c2119da with --trace on, Playwright 1.63.0): 455 tests, all passed, one <test folder>/trace.zip each in workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-animals-fit/. report.json in that folder is the Playwright JSON report (preceded by npm and webpack log lines) and maps every test to its trace folder; the full index (spec file, line, describe › test title, status, trace folder) is in distil/extract/trace-animals-fit.work/index.tsv. Two Playwright projects: "journeys" (fit/journey-smoke.fit.spec.js, 4 tests) and "features" (28 spec files under src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/, 451 tests). Tests per spec: journey-smoke 4, page-title 2, section-caption 5, service-navigation 7, dashboard 15, notification-actions 4, delete-notification 5, cancel-amend 5, hub 22, origin 33, import-reason 21, commodities/search 14, commodities/consignment-details 18, commodities/identification 46, additional-details 9, contact 6, cph-number 15, addresses/hub-picker 27, addresses/party-edit 5, transport/arrival-transit 39, transport/transporters 53, transport/commercial-transporter-details 27, documents/upload 28, documents/scan-status 4, documents/drop-zone 6, documents/guidance 4, check-answers 21, declaration 5, confirmation 5. Each fit test drives one feature page or a short run of pages against stubbed backends, so a trace shows the real frontend's rendered pages, copy, validation and redirects for that feature, not a whole journey. The scope takes in every trace; nothing is left out. The corpus covers only what the fit specs walk: the INS dashboard and address book (other repos) are not here, and a page or branch no fit test reaches leaves no trace. Cut into 26 parts in journey order, by spec file, with the seven largest specs (origin, identification, hub-picker, arrival-transit, transporters, commercial-transporter-details, upload) split on their describe blocks so no part holds more than 25 traces.
